description:
How many yellow things did you find with your eyes closed?

That’s your reticular activating system, the RAS, doing its job. It’s a filter. Billions of signals come in, a handful get through, and what gets through is whatever you’ve told it matters. You said “brown”, so it deleted yellow. Then you said “yellow”, and now it can’t stop showing you yellow.

Your brain doesn’t show you what’s there. It shows you what you’re looking for.

Founders do this with their business every day. Look for proof that it won’t work: you’ll find it. Look for the next client, the next yes, the next thing that’s working: you’ll find that instead. Same room. Same numbers. Different search.

The question isn’t whether the proof exists. It’s what you’ve set the filter to. That’s why I make founders write the one result that matters every morning: it’s not a to-do list, it’s a setting.

Comment what you want to find this week. And if you want the version of this I do with clients to reset what they’re looking for each morning, follow me and comment “RESET”.
transcript: Do this with me, it will only take 40 seconds. Look around the room and find everything that is brown. Chair, door, floor, table is not brown. Look for everything that is brown. Okay, now close your eyes and count all the things that are yellow. Now open your eyes, look around, and find everything that is yellow. How many things you missed? This is how our reticular activating system works. You're not synced with your eyes, you're actually synced with your brain, and this system filters out reality. You see only what you want to see. So if you want to find a reason why your business will fail, you will find them every single day. And if you want to find the next client, well, you'll find it as well. So tell me, write in the comments, what do you want to find this week?
